citation.title: DL-Scale: Deep Learning for model upgrading in topology optimization
citation.authors: Nikos Ath. Kallioras, Nikos D. Lagaros

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: On one benchmark problem, DL-Scale reduced end-to-end SIMP runtime by 48.61% to 71.92% across four mesh sizes while reaching slightly lower compliance values.
claim.key_phrase: minimize the computational load of topology optimization
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: At 100,000 elements, classical SIMP took 540.44 s and DL-Scale 151.74 s; 540.44 / 151.74 = 3.56. Table 1 reports 71.92% time reduction for this case.
claim.alternatives: Abstract qualitatively says the method reduces computational load by reducing dense-mesh SIMP iterations. Table 1 also reports achieved time savings of 48.61%, 60.15%, 65.56%, and 71.92% at 20,000, 50,000, 75,000, and 100,000 elements.

baseline.implementation: SIMP with finite element analysis; optimizer/implementation details not stated
baseline.problem_size: One 2D benchmark problem, compared at 20,000, 50,000, 75,000, and 100,000 finite elements (Section 4, Table 1)
baseline.classical_iterations: 219, 245, 277, and 321 iterations to convergence at the four mesh sizes (Table 1)
baseline.data_generation_cost: 200,000 input-output pairs generated by optimizing two 100,000-element beam problems with SIMP; generation runtime not stated (Section 3.2)
baseline.quality_metric: compliance objective and final volume fraction (Sections 3.1, 4)
baseline.quality_gap: DL-Scale's objective value is reported as 1.00–2.00% lower than SIMP across all four meshes; final target volume is 35% (Section 4, Table 1).

R1.evidence: Section 4/Table 1: same test setup and 35% target volume; DL-Scale is compared end-to-end with SIMP to convergence and has 1.00–2.00% lower compliance objective values.

R2.evidence: Section 4/Table 1: SIMP is run to convergence; no qualifying inefficient solver or hardware mismatch is established (hardware and solver details are not stated).

R3.evidence: Section 3.2 reports 200,000 training pairs generated with SIMP, but neither data-generation runtime nor DBN training cost is reported.

R4.evidence: Section 4/Table 1 reports compliance objective and the target volume for final designs, but does not report infeasible-design or failure rates.

reporting.n_test_cases: One benchmark problem at four mesh sizes (Section 4, Table 1).

notes: Full text read from the author-uploaded copy at https://www.researchgate.net/publication/341140628_DL-Scale_Deep_Learning_for_model_upgrading_in_topology_optimization. Article license is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no experiment code is stated as available.
